filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Tue Nov 10 (after the morning run) – Wed Nov 11 morning PT (items already on the Nov 10 brief not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: Written skills are becoming the unit sales teams package and share: Salesforce made AI Skills generally available in Agentforce Coworker, and Anthropic put Claude directly into meetings, beside the CRM and work apps, with plugins that ship their own sales skills.

bullets.text: Nov 10: AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker are GA. A user describes a repeatable task (account research, call prep and record sync, battle cards) in plain language, edits it in Skill Builder, and shares it; skills run as the signed-in user with their permissions and pause for approval before creating or updating a record.

Nov 10: Claude Meetings (beta, Team and Enterprise, Google Meet first) joins calls as a visible participant, drafts plans and answers questions live, and leaves notes, action items, and follow-ups in claude.ai; it won't join calls with external guests unless an admin allows it. Interactive connectors now open apps such as HubSpot, Adobe, and Atlassian inside Claude.
Nov 10: Clay published an updated GTM engineer hiring guide with interview questions, take-home ideas, and compensation benchmarks, saying it coined the title in 2023.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings, Sheets, Whiteboards, and Claude Data
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 10: Meetings (beta, Team/Enterprise, Google Meet) puts Claude into live calls; Sheets and Whiteboards are in beta on paid plans; Claude Dashboards becomes Claude Data (GA), connecting to warehouses and CRMs. Enterprise admins get Claude Data on by default from Nov 19.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI opens Businesses in ChatGPT with Business Agents
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 10 (beta): businesses claim a verified profile in Business Hub, add product feeds, and see aggregated mentions and clicks; eligible US ecommerce and online-service businesses can launch a Business Agent, which can also be sponsored as a ChatGPT Ads destination.

biggest_ai_news.title: Microsoft AI prices MAI Transcribe 2 at $0.10 per audio hour
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 10: 60-language speech-to-text with built-in diarization and word timestamps (promo rate through 2026); a streaming version for live voice agents is $0.54 per audio hour.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic IPO terms point to up to $1.4T valuation
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 10–11: at the top of the $70–$78 range the offering raises about $64.4B; Axios reports October run-rate revenue of $81B. Pricing is reported for Nov 18, trading Nov 19.

what_changed.title: Salesforce makes AI Skills generally available in Agentforce Coworker
what_changed.body: Nov 10: users build reusable, shareable task instructions by chatting with Coworker or in Skill Builder; run with / or by intent; private by default; run with the user's row- and object-level permissions and pause before record writes. Coworker is the first Agentforce agent with AI Skills. No pricing change stated beyond the existing $50/user/month Coworker plan.

what_changed.title: Salesforce Catalog gives outside agents a permission-aware map of the org
what_changed.body: Nov 10: a continuously updated index of objects, fields, flows, Apex, permission sets, and Data 360 components, searchable by meaning through an MCP server (Metadata Grounding MCP is beta). Salesforce says Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other assistants can sign in and read it as the user; available in editions that support Data 360.

what_changed.title: Anthropic puts Claude into meetings and work apps
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 10: Claude Meetings beta (live note-taking, plans, action items, follow-ups; external-guest calls blocked unless admin-authorized), Claude Sheets and Whiteboards betas, Claude Data GA, and interactive connectors that open HubSpot, Adobe, Atlassian, and others inside Claude.

what_changed.title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT and Business Agents
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 10: verified business profiles, product feeds, aggregated engagement insights (mentions, clicks, discovery topics), and Business Agents for eligible US ecommerce and online-service businesses; OpenAI says it doesn't share user conversations with businesses.

what_changed.title: Salesforce AgentExchange private offers can bundle partner SaaS and services
what_changed.body: Nov 10: partners can sell managed packages, partner-hosted SaaS, and professional services in one private offer, with 24- or 36-month terms and pre-populated renewals.

quiet_note: No new launch/funding/M&A/pricing from Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, or Monaco dated Nov 10–11 beyond Gong's November release (led Nov 10) and Clay's GTM engineer hiring guide. Salesloft newsroom still tops out at the Oct 27 Agentic Playbook early-access post. Salesforce's Nov 10 Missionforce 'Awardable' status, internal security-triage agent post, and Nov 11 SFR-AutoR&D research post (autonomous agents that improved its Data Cloud embedding model) are logged on the competitor page only.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (skills as the packaging for sales workflows)
market_direction.text: Salesforce AI Skills GA (Nov 10) follows Gong's agent and skill templates (Nov 10); both run under existing user permissions with approval before writes.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (horizontal assistants moving into calls and CRM)
market_direction.text: Claude Meetings joins live calls and Claude now opens HubSpot and other apps in place (Nov 10), while Salesforce Catalog lets Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor read org metadata through MCP.

market_direction.label: New (AI chat as a buyer discovery channel)
market_direction.text: OpenAI's Business Hub and Business Agents (Nov 10) let companies manage how they show up in ChatGPT and talk to prospects there, with sponsored placements.

market_direction.label: Steady (rest of watchlist)
market_direction.text: Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Monaco quiet Nov 10–11; Salesloft Agentic Playbook still early access.

Salesforce's editor for reviewing and changing a skill's steps directly (Nov 10).
A live, permission-aware index of how an org is built, exposed to agents through MCP (Nov 10).
Claude as a visible call participant that drafts plans and follow-ups during the meeting (Nov 10).
OpenAI's business-run agent inside ChatGPT that answers prospects' questions about its offerings (Nov 10).
Clay's job title, now with a hiring guide and compensation benchmarks (Nov 10).

competitive_moves.text: AI Skills GA in Agentforce Coworker (Nov 10); Salesforce Catalog org-metadata index with MCP access for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor (Nov 10); AgentExchange private offers that bundle partner SaaS and services with multi-year terms (Nov 10).
Updated GTM engineer hiring guide with interview questions, take-homes, and compensation benchmarks (Nov 10).

watch.title: Anthropic IPO pricing (reported Nov 18); Claude Data default-on for Enterprise Nov 19; Coworker November GA items; Salesloft Agentic Playbook GA/pricing
watch.body: Pricing is reported for Nov 18 with trading Nov 19 under ANT. Anthropic turns Claude Data on by default for Enterprise orgs on Nov 19. Salesforce still lists Coworker in Teams, the desktop/mobile apps, and the Coworker MCP server for November. Salesloft newsroom is still on the Oct 27 early-access post.

interpretation.fact: Nov 10 Salesforce made AI Skills GA in Agentforce Coworker, published Salesforce Catalog (org-metadata index with an MCP server), and expanded AgentExchange private offers. Nov 10 Anthropic launched Claude Meetings (beta), Sheets and Whiteboards (beta), Claude Data (GA), and interactive connectors. Nov 10 OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT and Business Agents (beta). Nov 10 Microsoft AI released MAI Transcribe 2 at $0.10 per audio hour. Nov 10 Clay posted a GTM engineer hiring guide. Salesloft newsroom still Oct 27.
interpretation.interpretation: Within two days Gong and Salesforce both shipped skills that capture a team's best workflow and run it under existing permissions, so 'skills' is settling as the admin-facing unit for revenue agents. Meanwhile Anthropic is pushing Claude into the call itself and into CRM-adjacent apps, which puts a horizontal assistant in direct contact with meeting capture and follow-up work that revenue platforms have owned.
